podcast.title: SoundCloud Origins
podcast.body: KennyHoopla, like Bakar, began his career by posting his music to SoundCloud, achieving significant early success with his track "Cave." "He started by posting stuff to Sam Cloud, and one of the songs was called Cave. It became the most streamed song of all time on Sam Cloud."
